For the Quarter For the Six

(a) During the first quarter of fiscal 1997, the Company disposed of the assets and discontinued Digiflex, its advertisement delivery operation. Digiflex was acquired at the end of January 1996. The loss from discontinued operations includes oper loss of $128,000 and a loss on disposal of $75,000; no income tax benefits have been allocated to the loss in 1997. The results of operations for the period ended May 3, 1996 restated to reflect the discontinued operation. The loss from the discontinued operation for the six months ended May 3, 1996 includes an operating loss of $170,000, net of a tax benefit of $105,000, on revenues of $111,000.

(b) The mergers of Autologic, Inc. a unit of Volt Information Sciences, Inc. -- (NYSE: VOL )) and Information International, Inc., into the Company, and which now form the Company's operations, was completed at the end of the Company's first quarter of fiscal 1996. The first quarter of fiscal 1996 included a $700,000 restructuring charge and certain rent and general administration expenses that have been reduced since the mergers; and the results of operations for the six months ended May 3, 1996 reflect the results of operations of Autologic only for the first quarter of 1996. Therefore, results of the combined operations for the six months ended May 2, 1997 are not comparable to results for the six months ended May 3, 1996.
